title: Codex high-fidelity execution under complete bounded patch packages
confirmed_facts: The patch repository explicitly prohibited redesign, reinterpretation, asset replacement, Tailwind conversion and changes to copy, hierarchy, colors, spacing, shadows, animations or responsive behavior.
The patch repository identified the approved source repository, branch and source commit.
The implementation repository records a migration of the approved Carolina MD landing to Next.js and subsequent responsive polish.
Codex can execute high-fidelity transformations when the target, source, preservation rules, forbidden changes and validation expectations are operationally explicit.

claim_assessment.claim: Codex is extremely precise following well-specified instructions.

strategy_reassessment.methodological_consequence: Treat original visual creation as an intent-driven patch package with the same operational precision used in successful technical migrations, while preserving creative freedom and human visual authority.
